morphology_keys.leaf_morphology: Elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, dark glossy green, smooth surface
morphology_keys.inflorescence: Compact, snow-white umbels on thin peduncles
morphology_keys.gynostegium_detail: Prominent white hoods forming a symmetrical star-like corona
morphology_keys.growth_habit: Semi-woody base, multi-stemmed bush habit (30-50 cm)

comparisons.key_distinctions: A. texana is restricted to dry limestone bluffs, canyons, and wooded slopes in Central/West Texas; A. perennis is a wetland species of aquatic margins.

ecological_notes.host_status: Excellent shade-tolerant host for Monarchs in Edwards Plateau canyon microclimates.
ecological_notes.habitat: Limestone canyon walls, rocky wooded ravines, and dry bluffs.
